# SNS Furniture

> SNS Furniture is a California custom furniture and interior design brand. Custom Furniture and Design Services are its primary offerings; curated stock furniture for the living room, dining room, bedroom, mattresses and accent spaces is available under Stock Furniture. Delivery throughout California.

## Business facts
- Website: https://snsfurniture.com
- Operated by: SNS Furniture is a fictitious business name operated by Sash & Shade.
- Phone: (424) 310-6199 (text or call)
- Email: info@snsfurniture.com
- Service area: California. Online checkout is available for California delivery addresses only; for other destinations, please inquire.
- Delivery: a flat delivery fee is quoted separately at checkout; delivery is scheduled after the order is placed.
- Design service: free in-home design service
- Business address (legal): 1575 Westwood Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90024

## Product information
Every stock furniture product has its own page (https://snsfurniture.com/product/<sku>/) with the product name, SKU, specifications, photographs, price and Product structured data. Stock furniture is supplied by ACME Furniture and Furniture of America.

## Accuracy note
Availability, colors, finishes, dimensions, prices and delivery options should be confirmed with SNS Furniture before purchase. Custom furniture specifications and pricing are confirmed during a design consultation.
